$comment: Bank-approved copy (demo). Conventional templates are seeded as 'approved'; Islamic as 'sharia_approved'. Syntax: {fact}, [[fact: shown when fact is non-zero]], [[!fact: shown when fact is zero]]. Doha Demo Bank is fictional. 'generic' entries carry no customer data and are served when no consent is on record (non-negotiable 5). 'factLabels' label the fact chips; 'explanations' word the 'Why am I seeing this?' reasons. Labels and explanations are shared by both variants, so they use variant-neutral terms.

templates.headline: Before you close your account
templates.body: Closing an account stops standing orders and returns cheques that have not been presented, and cards paid from it need a new account. A closure fee may apply. You can review what uses this account in the app, or ask us, before you continue.

templates.headline: قبل إغلاق حسابك
templates.body: إغلاق الحساب يوقف أوامر الدفع الدائمة ويعيد الشيكات التي لم تُقدَّم، وتحتاج البطاقات التي تُسدَّد منه إلى حساب جديد. قد تُطبَّق رسوم إغلاق. يمكنك مراجعة ما يستخدم هذا الحساب في التطبيق أو سؤالنا قبل المتابعة.
